zboard

“Dashboard do Zé”: a daily-updated, static dashboard of CRAN check and download health, GitHub activity and academic output for my R packages.

  • Dashboard: https://evandeilton.github.io/zboard/dashboard/ (pt)
  • Package documentation: https://evandeilton.github.io/zboard/

Installation 

pak::pak("evandeilton/zboard")

Usage 

library(zboard)
collect_cran(); collect_github(); collect_academic()   # sources -> staging/
consolidate()                                          # staging/ -> data/
export_json()                                          # data/ -> site/_data/

collect_github() needs GITHUB_TOKEN; collect_academic() needs OPENALEX_MAILTO. What is monitored is listed in config/repos.yml.
